timeline.body: On November 12, 2026, between 17:59 UTC and 19:05 UTC, the GitHub Webhooks API experienced elevated latency and timeouts. During this time, about 1.23% of Webhooks API requests were slower than normal or timed out, peaking at about 3.63% of requests for a short period. 0.14% of webhook API requests failed during the incident. Webhook deliveries were unaffected. We traced the slow responses to elevated latency in an upstream database service that the Webhooks API depends on. Latency returned to normal at 19:05 UTC, and we continued to monitor until we resolved the incident at 19:33 UTC.
